messages:
maya: Quick sync 1: prompt-sets approval flow + inline comment UX. Posted new prototype in Fig: (link). Key problems we saw in testing: 1) comment threads collide with selection checkboxes, 2) approving an entire prompt set hides contextual diffs, 3) keyboard flow for 'approve all' is unclear. Thoughts? sam: Saw the prototype. Re: checkbox overlap 11 tiny CSS fix: move comment affordance to right-aligned gutter and increase hit area. That keeps selection checkbox on the left stable. owen: Approving entire set should surface a small modal that summarizes regressions that would be approved. Not a blocker, but important to prevent accidental mass-approves. Modal copy should call out failures with counts and link to sample diffs. tara: Accessibility: modal needs focus trap + initial focus on the primary action. Also ensure the modal has role=\"dialog\" and aria-labelledby pointing to the header. Example: ```html
...
``` maya: Good. UX nit: when you open inline comments, they push the example text and hide the diff lanes in compact mode. Proposal: make inline comments overlay on hover/focus instead of expanding the row. On keyboard, comment opens via Enter key and dismisses with Esc. sam: Overlay works, but add a visible indicator that an example has comments (tiny dot in the left badge). That way compressed list still shows comment presence. owen: For the modal summary, microcopy suggestion: header: "Approve all 128 examples?" body: "This will accept current labels for all examples. 9 failures and 2 flaky items will be marked as approved. Review failures before proceeding." Primary button: "Approve selected" (destructive style) Secondary: "Review failures". tara: Keyboard: provide a keyboard-only path for approving current page: Shift+A to open modal, then Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel. Add aria-describedby to the primary button linking to a short note about reversibility: "Approvals can be reverted from the audit log." maya: Good call. Also request: when someone makes an inline comment, ping should include the prompt-set name and example index e.g., "@sam comment on PricingPrompt #42" so people can jump directly. Bot can format: ```ai-evals-bot: @sam commented on PricingPrompt (#42): 'Output is missing currency symbol' - view link``` ai-evals-bot: New comment detected on run 1756777777. Notifying @sam. sam: Small copy tweak: change "Approve selected" to "Confirm approvals"? Feels clearer that action is final. But I worry it sounds heavier. Any preference? own: "Confirm approvals" is explicit. Our other flows use "Approve" though. Consistency > novelty. I'd stick with "Approve selected" but maybe show a sublabel: "This action can be undone in the audit log." tara: Also: ensure pluralization in the modal (1 failure vs N failures) and that screen-reader announcement reads numbers: use `aria-live` on the summary line. maya: Action items: 1) Sam 11 implement gutter for comments + dot indicator; 2) Owen 11 update modal copy & prototype; 3) Tara 11 add aria attributes snippet and keyboard mappings to the accessibility checklist; 4) Maya 11 update Fig and push new prototype. Target: first pass by Tue. sam: I'll ship a small CSS PR and add unit tests for keyboard behavior. own: I'll sketch modal states (no failures, some failures, all failures). tara: I'll paste the accessibility checklist here once done. maya: Thanks team. If anyone hits edge cases (e.g., sorting by failures then approving) call them out in this thread. :sparkles:
